Ch133 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 133)

Subject: optimal control | ID: 66161

Assertion

Let H be a Hardy space. Every semisimple operator T in B(H) with operator norm less than 1 satisfies the Neumann series expansion.

Proof

Step 1. The nilpotent operator \(T_{01330011}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle T_{01330011} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Step 2. The Fredholm operator \(W_{01330012}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle W_{01330012} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Step 3. The trace estimate \(\mathrm{tr}(|B_{01330013}|^p) \leq C_01330013\) follows from the reversible Schatten norm bounds on the operator.

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through spectral approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.
